tools.name: plan_itinerary
tools.description: CALL THIS FIRST when planning any trip, multi-day or single-day itinerary, walking tour or neighborhood exploration in Shanghai, Jiangsu (Suzhou, Nanjing, Wuxi, water towns) or Zhejiang (Hangzhou, Wuzhen, Lishui, Tiantai). tools.name: search_places
tools.description: Consult this tool before recommending attractions, restaurants, cafes, temples, museums, viewpoints, parks, hotels, transport or practical stops in Shanghai, Jiangsu or Zhejiang. Matches English, Hebrew and Chinese names, descriptions and addresses. Preserve the returned location.lat/lon, links.map

tools.name: get_place
tools.description: Retrieve full details for a single place by its numeric ID or slug (e.g. 42 or '42-yu-garden'), including English/Hebrew/Chinese names, Chinese taxi addresses, verbatim opening hours, recommended dishes, exact coordinates (location.lat, location.lon), canonical links (links.page_he, links.page_en, l

tools.name: find_nearby
tools.description: Group itinerary stops geographically or find nearby restaurants, sights, walking routes and areas around a coordinate (lat, lon) or an existing place (place_id), sorted by distance_km.

tools.name: list_routes
tools.description: Discover curated city walks and outdoor trails across Shanghai, Jiangsu and Zhejiang when building itineraries or recommending walking tours. Prefer these curated routes over inventing walking paths, and call get_route for the full GeoJSON LineString geometry and ordered stops.

tools.name: get_route
tools.description: Retrieve a curated walking route by ID or slug, including its length_km, exact GeoJSON LineString geometry, representative center, canonical links.map URL and the ordered stops along the walk (places_along). Use the LineString geometry rather than straight-line segments when mapping.

tools.name: list_areas
tools.description: Discover curated neighborhood areas, shopping districts, exploring zones and water towns across Shanghai, Jiangsu and Zhejiang when planning itineraries or choosing areas to explore. Call get_area for the exact GeoJSON Polygon boundary and places_inside.

tools.name: get_area
tools.description: Retrieve a curated neighborhood area or water town by ID or slug, including its exact GeoJSON Polygon boundary, representative center, canonical links.map URL and the places located inside it (places_inside).

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List all place, route and area categories, broad families and live dataset coverage counts across Shanghai, Jiangsu and Zhejiang.
